summary: Mountain Crest Acquisition 6 Corp. filed an 8-K announcing the separate trading of its ordinary shares and rights from its units, effective June 22, 2026. Units trade on Nasdaq under MCAHU; separated shares and rights trade under MCAH and MCAHR, respectively. This is a routine post-IPO operational update—no acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other special situation. The company is a blank-check SPAC, but the filing merely facilitates unit separation, not a business combination or liquidation event. No deal terms, premiums, or pending transactions are mentioned; thus, it is not a special situation requiring categorization beyond 'None.'
